title: nanocrew Settings
description: Runtime settings for the nanocrew agent loop. Place in <workspace>/.nanocrew/settings.json (team) or .nanocrew/settings.local.json (personal, gitignored).

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — add this to get IDE autocomplete.

model.description: Override the LLM model for this workspace. E.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'.

permissions.description: Permission tier and rule engine configuration.

mode.description: Active permission tier. 'workspace_write' allows file read/write within the workspace. 'danger_full_access' also allows exec/spawn. 'prompt' asks the user for every tool call. 'allow' is for trusted Docker containers.

rules.description: Ordered list of allow/deny/ask rules. Evaluated before the tier check. Lists accumulate across config tiers.

decision.description: 'allow' grants access, 'deny' blocks it, 'ask' prompts the user.

pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against 'tool_name' or 'tool_name:serialised_args'. Examples: 'exec:git *', 'write_file:*', 'exec:rm -rf*'.

hooks.description: Shell commands run at tool lifecycle events. Lists accumulate across config tiers.

command.description: Shell command to run. Receives a JSON payload on stdin; should write a JSON result to stdout.

matcher.description: Glob over tool name. Defaults to '*' (all tools).

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before the hook is killed.

on_error.description: 'continue' treats hook failures as warnings. 'deny' blocks the tool call on hook failure.

threshold_tokens.description: Compact the in-context message list when input tokens exceed this value. Set to 0 to disable.

keep_tail.description: Number of recent messages to preserve after compaction.

log_dir.description: Directory for JSONL telemetry files. Defaults to <workspace>/.nanocrew/telemetry/. Overridden by nanocrew_LOG_DIR env var.

redact_content.description: Strip message content from telemetry events, keeping structure. For regulated environments.

mcp_servers.description: Agent-level MCP servers spawned at startup (stdio transport).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process.

disabled.description: Tool names to skip at registration time.

credentials.description: Service credentials for local dev (injected into env vars). Use only in settings.local.json — never commit secrets.
